description: You can view the files in your cloud storage, perform file operations, watch the videos with subtitle support, download media files for offline usage and link your put.io account with our Apple TV and other official apps!
whatsNew:
Two years of work, finally out.
- Redesigned throughout: new type, new icons, a calmer dark look
- Reworked downloads
- Privacy controls in Account: choose whether to share diagnostics and product analytics
- Contact us opens a support chat, and tapping a reply notification takes you there
- put.io links open straight in the app
